newsitem.title: USA: FDA to let Gull Labs market Toxo IgG ELISA.
newsitem.headline: FDA to let Gull Labs market Toxo IgG ELISA.

text.p: Medical products maker Gull Laboratories Inc said Tuesday it had obtained clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its new quantitative Toxo IgG ELISA Test.
Gull said the test assists in the diagnosis of infection with the protozoan, Toxoplasma gondii, which can cause a range of birth defects in newborns.
Infections in adults are often clinically inapparent or difficult to distinguish from infections with other organisms, it added.
Gull said the global market for serological testing for Toxoplasma infection was estimated to be about $100 million.
The company, based in Salt Lake City, Utah, markets its products for use in private laboratories and hospital clinical laboratories.
